name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena Petrović's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Belgrade, she excelled in mathematics and physics, initially pursuing a career in engineering. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team during a university project ignited a passion for the technical intricacies of racing. She transitioned to motorsport, quickly establishing herself as a meticulous and analytical engineer.

Milena's approach as Technical Director is characterized by her relentless pursuit of perfection. She believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the car's performance to identify areas for improvement. Known for her demanding yet fair leadership, she fosters a culture of continuous learning and innovation within her team. Her ability to remain calm and focused under pressure has been instrumental in guiding her teams through challenging races and technical setbacks. Her distinctive quality is her ability to see the big picture while meticulously attending to the smallest details, ensuring a holistic approach to performance optimization.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle highlights.
physical.description: Milena has a commanding presence with a sharp, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Insists on a perfectly clean and organized workspace, even at the racetrack.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
